text:
mike: opened PR to rename Stellaris variants and add an availability note across regions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5122 — want quick eyes on wording + small bench table for latency differences between variants.

asha: quick context: we currently expose stellaris-lite as a variant name in the catalog but the runtime expects stellaris-lite3b. makes confusion in /variants API and playground. PR proposed canonicalizing names to match runtime.

ravi: agree. also add note about region availability: EU region currently has only non-quant and lite3b, APAC coming later this quarter. need a one-liner under Availability and a short migration snippet for customers who pinned old names.

mike: added a short table with p50 medians from a quick p4d run (batch=1):
- stellaris-nonquant: 210ms
- stellaris-lite3b: 120ms
- stellaris-4bit-adapter: 140ms
I uploaded CSV: https://drive.google.com/stellaris-variants-bench.csv

leo: nit: SDK snippet in the PR uses `variant: "lite"` (old name). update to `variant: "stellaris-lite3b"` and show both a curl and SDK v4 example for pinning. small code blocks.

asha: wording suggestion for Availability: "Stellaris variants are rolling out region-by-region. If you rely on a specific variant, pin the variant or use the model alias that maps to an available variant in your region." Keep it short.

mike: added migration examples. curl pin example:
```bash
# pin variant for Dedicated or Reserved customers
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/variants -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model":"stellaris","variant":"stellaris-lite3b"}'
```
SDK v4 snippet (js):
```js
await client.variants.create({
  model: "stellaris",
  variant: "stellaris-lite3b",
  note: "pin during region migration",
});
```

ravi: add a compatibility note: `stellaris-4bit-adapter` currently disables some streaming optimizations on small GPUs; mention that as a one-line under Compatibility.

leo: also add a small FAQ entry: "Why did my pin stop working?" -> explain variant renames and recommend search & replace in infra configs.

docbot: docs-lint: failed \u001f1a7 - missing region list link.

mike: added link to /regions/availability and short bullet list: EU: nonquant, lite3b; NA: all variants; APAC: nonquant only (ETA 2026-06).

docbot: docs-lint: passed \u2705 preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/5122/ (staging)

asha: left one tiny wording nit in the migration snippet (escape JSON in curl). will push a small fix.

mike: fixed curl quoting and updated the bench note to clarify test hardware. will merge after CI and product ack.

ravi: +1

leo: +1

asha: +1

mike: thanks everyone. merging once green. follow-up: file an infra ticket to sweep configs that reference old variant names.

docbot: thread archived by docbot.
